bio.text: Tim Lamb, a Grand Forks attorney, accepted the Democratic-NPL Party's nomination for North Dakota attorney general in 2026, according to the Grand Forks Herald.
He previously ran for attorney general in 2022, losing to Drew Wrigley, and for state auditor in 2024.

According to a biography he gave the Grand Forks Herald, he was born in Grand Forks and holds a journalism degree from the University of North Dakota, a business master's degree from Central Michigan University and a law degree from the UND School of Law.
The same biography says he served in the U.S. Army for more than 20 years; the Herald also reports he spent 15 years on the Grand Forks School Board.

sources.title: Grand Forks Attorney Tim Lamb pursues attorney general position
